description: Find your break-even point in units and revenue from fixed costs, price per unit and variable cost per unit.

faqs.a: Break-even units = fixed costs ÷ (price − variable cost). Break-even revenue = break-even units × price.
You must raise the price, cut variable costs, or reduce fixed costs — otherwise each unit sold loses money.
faqs.q: What if price is below variable cost?

faqs.a: Enter a target profit as extra fixed cost… simplest: required units = (fixed costs + target profit) ÷ contribution margin.
faqs.q: How do I add a target profit?

Read the break-even units and revenue instantly.
Sell more than the break-even units to profit.
